title: Find why the export Stop check (#1288) let a page writer skip exports all day
why: Owner 19:02 CST Nov 6: a session wrote 'From now on, every wake that changes the page ends with an export. That step is in my handoff.' The owner: such a promise must be a mechanical change, not a line in a handoff (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard). Incident: a page writer changed items all day but exported only before a republish (decision waiting-data-in-repo says export after each wake).
note: The check already exists: step waiting-export-check, done in #1288 (a Stop hook refuses when this turn wrote the page and no later commit touched waiting/). Yet a page writer changed items all day without exporting and answered with a handoff promise. Lane: find which session and repo (likely a child repo, or a page not registered in layout-extras, or writes made outside the hooked turn), make the check fire there, red test first. Also flag a 'from now on' promise whose only home is a handoff (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard). Lane session_013NEJL1JwGYbs71pjwKZCfb started as an owner ask under item 387 a (coordinator, 22:33 CST Nov 7).
